review:
The Aztec characters on a Megaways grid, so the ways to win change every spin. Scatters land anywhere: three, four, five or six of them give 8, 10, 12 or 16 free spins.

The wilds on reels 2 to 5 carry a 2x or 3x multiplier, and when several are in the same win, they multiply each other – two 3x wilds make that win 9x. That's where this game can suddenly explode. Very high volatility, 12,960x max and an excellent 96.96% RTP. Free spins about once every 259 spins on average.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
